summary: Round 2 on THE CROSSING (r1 FAIL 6/10) + closing W1-05's mandatory reachability proof. The reverse jam is a WORLD defect: the road passes over itself. Fixed in build-roads.mjs with a self-clearance pass.
next_step: Install new roads.json, regenerate derived data, then walk every leg BOTH ways in one browser.
notes: contention --gate at start: GO, 3 browser instances, load 2.21/core
redundant_with W1-01-r4 (crossing tooling) and W1-05 (roads.json / build-roads.mjs / signposts) — this piece was dispatched to close W1-05's reachability proof, so the overlap is deliberate.
findings: R2-F1 (THE CAUSE OF THE REVERSE JAM, measured offline, no browser): the road passes OVER ITSELF. `stormhold-helstrom` segment 126->127 and segment 130->131 CROSS, at (2280.6, 1862.2), with 6.6 m of air between them — the return limb of a switchback over the outbound limb, and points 129-131 are a declared 17 m viaduct. A deck slab is `half_width + 0.5` = 3.5 m either side of its centreline, so the upper deck is laid across the lower carriageway. `field.heightAt` is a HEIGHTFIELD (one surface per x,z): `_deckY` returns the HIGHEST slab and `_applyRoads` breaks an equal-weight tie in favour of the higher segment — both deliberate and documented, and neither can represent two carriageways at one coordinate. New census `tools/world/w1-crossing-r2-overpass.mjs`: at commit 2e740f3 exactly ONE offence run in the whole 25 km network, `stormhold-helstrom` 1633-1639 m, the carriageway buried 6.99 m (road_y 83.92, deck_y 90.92). Control arm (every deck_span deleted) = 0, so the census measures slabs and not terrain.

R2-F2 (THE FIX IS IN THE GENERATOR, NOT IN field.js): a scalar heightfield cannot carry an overpass, so the invariant is authored instead — `build-roads.mjs` gains a `selfClearance()` post-pass: no two non-adjacent stretches of one leg may come within `hw + 0.5 + hw*1.15 + 0.5` (7.45 m at hw=3) of each other; where they do, the excursion between them is spliced out at the point of closest approach. `--no-self-clear` is the delete-the-fix arm. FIFTEEN places in six legs were within reach of themselves; only one of them currently buried a carriageway, the other fourteen were latent.

R2-F3 (the generator reproduces byte-for-byte, which is what made the diff readable): `build-roads.mjs --out <tmp>` on the untouched tree is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the shipped `game/data/world/roads.json`, so every difference after the change is the change.
